about.caption: FACTORY STRENGTH — 工厂实力
about.title: 从一块亚克力板材，到一只成品浴缸
about.p1: 胜昌实业坐落于制造业重镇广东东莞，拥有从板材裁切、真空吸塑成型、玻纤树脂加固到成品试水检测的完整产线。每一只浴缸都在同一厂区内完成全部工序，品质全程可控。
about.p2: 我们长期服务于大洋洲、欧洲、北美与东南亚的卫浴品牌与进口商，熟悉各国认证与装柜标准，支持小批量试单与整柜混装。

products.caption: PRODUCT LINES — 产品系列
products.title: 四大产品线，覆盖主流卫浴市场
products.desc: 所有系列支持尺寸、颜色、排水位与五金配件定制，整柜起订，支持混装。

items.name: 独立式浴缸
items.spec: 1500–1800mm · 薄边/厚边 · 亮光/哑光
items.detail: 独立式浴缸是出口市场需求最大的品类。我们按客户图纸或样品开模，常规长度 1500–1800mm，可选薄边或厚边、亮光或哑光表面，底部配钢架结构与可调脚，整柜出运。

items.name: 嵌入式浴缸
items.detail: 嵌入式浴缸适合与台面、瓷砖整合安装，常规长度 1400–1800mm，宽台面设计方便放置用品，可按需配裙边与溢水口位置，适合家装连锁与工程项目。

items.name: 深泡浴缸
items.spec: 日式深泡 · 加高靠背 · 人体工学内腔
items.detail: 深泡浴缸采用日式深泡设计，加高靠背与人体工学内腔，占地小、水深足，适合小户型与精品酒店项目，尺寸与排水位可定制。

items.name: 淋浴底盘
items.spec: 方/长/扇形 · 防滑底纹 · 薄边设计
items.detail: 淋浴底盘提供方形、长方形与扇形，底部防滑纹理，薄边设计便于无障碍进出。可配同色排水盖，整柜混装可与浴缸拼柜出运。

oem.caption: OEM / ODM — 合作流程
oem.title: 五个步骤，把您的设计变成货柜里的产品

steps.d: 确认目标市场、尺寸范围、认证要求与预期价格带，24 小时内回复可行性评估。
来图来样均可，15–25 天完成模具与首样，提供 3D 图纸确认。
寄样实测，按反馈修改细节，确认包装方案与唛头。
标准交期 30–35 天，产中提供照片与视频进度汇报。
支持第三方验货，出口加固包装，深圳港整柜/拼柜出运。

oem.note: 支持品牌 LOGO 丝印 · 定制说明书与纸箱 · 条码与唛头服务

items.d: 亚克力板材厚度、色差与杂质抽检，源头控制。

hero.caption: DONGGUAN · CHINA — SINCE 2008
hero.sub: Dongguan Shengchang Industries Limited — an OEM / ODM manufacturer of acrylic bathtubs and shower trays, delivering everything from vacuum forming to container loading under one roof.

about.caption: FACTORY STRENGTH
about.title: From an acrylic sheet to a finished bathtub
about.p1: Based in Dongguan, Guangdong — the heart of China’s manufacturing — Shengchang runs a complete in-house production line: sheet cutting, vacuum forming, fiberglass & resin reinforcement, and final water testing. Every bathtub is finished inside a single facility, with quality controlled end to end.
about.p2: We have long served sanitary ware brands and importers across Oceania, Europe, North America and Southeast Asia, and are fluent in the certification and container-loading standards of each market. Trial orders and mixed containers are welcome.

products.caption: PRODUCT LINES
products.title: Four product lines for mainstream markets
products.desc: Every series supports custom sizes, colors, drain positions and hardware. Full-container orders with mixed loading available.

items.name: Freestanding Bathtub
items.detail: Freestanding bathtubs are our highest-volume export line. We tool from your drawings or samples, with standard lengths of 1500–1800mm, slim or wide rims, gloss or matte finish, a steel support frame with adjustable feet, and full-container shipping.

items.name: Drop-in Bathtub
items.detail: Drop-in bathtubs integrate with tiled or stone decks. Standard lengths 1400–1800mm, a wide deck for toiletries, optional skirt and custom overflow position. Popular with home-improvement chains and project buyers.

items.name: Soaking Bathtub
items.spec: Japanese deep soak · Raised backrest · Ergonomic well
items.detail: Our soaking bathtubs follow the Japanese deep-soak format: raised backrest, ergonomic well, small footprint and generous water depth. Suited to compact apartments and boutique hotels; sizes and drain positions can be customised.

items.name: Shower Tray
items.spec: Square / rectangle / quadrant · Anti-slip · Slim edge
items.detail: Shower trays come in square, rectangular and quadrant formats with an anti-slip textured base and a slim edge for easy step-in. Colour-matched drain covers available; trays can be mixed with bathtubs in one container.

oem.caption: OEM / ODM PROCESS
oem.title: Five steps from your drawing to a loaded container

steps.d: Share your target market, size range, certification needs and price band. Feasibility reply within 24 hours.
Drawings or physical samples both work. Moulds and first sample in 15–25 days, with 3D drawings for approval.
Physical sample shipped for testing. Details refined, packing and shipping marks confirmed.
Standard lead time 30–35 days, with photo and video progress updates during production.
Third-party inspection supported. Export-grade packing, FCL/LCL from Shenzhen port.

oem.note: Logo silk-printing · Custom manuals & cartons · Barcode & shipping mark services

quality.caption: QUALITY ASSURANCE
quality.title: Four gates every bathtub must pass

items.d: Acrylic sheets checked for thickness, color consistency and impurities — quality controlled at the source.
Forming temperature, fiberglass layers and resin ratio recorded throughout production.
Every tub filled and rested to detect leakage; drainage systems tested one by one.
Surface gloss, load-bearing and packing integrity verified before warehousing.

quality.certsNote: Certifications cover major export markets; testing for specific countries can be arranged.

markets.desc: From home-improvement chains in New Zealand to sanitary ware importers in Germany, we organize production and loading to each market’s standard.
